text:
harper_sales: Kickoff thread for Magnus Bank POC. Need final scope on SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning auth, RBAC mapping style, domain verification process, and a committed Dedicated estimate. Finance says SOW + security QA required before budget.

vikram_se: Quick list from eng: IdP metadata (URL or XML), SP vs IdP-initiated, NameID format, SCIM auth (bearer vs mTLS), exact domains to validate, canonical group names, and whether they want per-route entitlements.

prod_contact_magnus: Hi all 94 we'll deliver IdP metadata URL today. SP-initiated preferred, NameID=email. SCIM via bearer token ok for POC; rotation 90 days. Domains: magnus.com and eu.magnus.com. We'll attach group list in follow-up.

lucy_ts: For RBAC we recommend groups->roles mapping for the POC (fastest). If you need claims-based rules later we can add a transform. Also confirm externalId format.

prod_contact_magnus: We'll use group->role mapping. externalId = "magnus|<employee-id>". We do want per-route entitlements for payments.* only.

carol_security: Security notes: POC bearer token = ok, production we strongly recommend mTLS for SCIM. Audit logs default 90 days (upgrade to 365d available). SAML cert rotation supported (manual + optional automated refresh). Domain verification = DNS TXT per domain; org-level delegation possible but requires extra verification and will add ~2-4 business days per external domain. We'll need completed security questionnaire before Dedicated commit.

vikram_se: SCIM sample we'll use for the smoke sync and mapping tests:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],
  "Resources": [
    {
      "id": "u-1001",
      "userName": "a.khan@magnus.com",
      "externalId": "magnus|1001",
      "emails": [{"value": "a.khan@magnus.com"}],
      "groups": ["payments","ops"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Mapping for POC: payments->payments-analyst, ops->infra-operator. Set SCIM initial rate-limit to 50 req/min.

li_legal: Legal: we need a short SOW clause for SSO/SCIM (metadata exchange, cert rotation, provisioning termination, data residency). I can paste a 3-4 line snippet when scope confirmed.

harper_sales: Pricing ask from Magnus: committed Dedicated for ~140 req/s sustained, ~1.4M tokens/day. Need monthly reserved + overage, EU residency, and 24/7 enterprise support. Vikram, please draft a customer-facing line-item estimate and call out caveats for per-route entitlements, domain-delegation onboarding, and quantized-model/latency tuning.

vikram_se: Will prepare the estimate. Handoff checklist for eng: IdP metadata, SCIM token, groups->roles mapping, DNS TXT entries for domains, and chosen data residency region. Need these by EOD to start staging config.

prod_contact_magnus: We'll get metadata, SCIM token, and group mapping to you by EOD. Can you provide SOW + estimate in 24h?

carol_security: I'll draft the security QA responses and a minimal SSO/SCIM SOW clause within 24h. Note: enabling per-route logging, tenant-scoped KMS, or mTLS will increase both cost and onboarding timeline.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: feature/magnus-identity-poc -> staging at 2024-11-01T03:00Z :rocket:

harper_sales: Thanks team. Sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
